results.name: Horse
results.description: This is a unique 3D model of a horse that combines the form of an animal with vibrant fruit features. The model is perfect for game development and animation projects, offering playful and imaginative design. It is rigged for animation, including idle, walk, and run,eat, cycles, and comes with basic materials. This model is optimized for performance and ready for integration into your projects. Ideal for developers and artists looking to add a fun and creative twist to their designs.

results.name: Horse Walk
results.description:
High-quality Horse Walk Animation provided as an Alembic (.abc) cache, intended only for cinematic and offline rendering workflows.

This asset is not game-ready and does not include a rig.
The animation is baked and optimized for smooth playback, making it ideal for film shots, visualization, previs, and high-quality renders.

The walk cycle features natural weight shift, realistic leg motion, and clean looping, suitable for realistic animal movement in cinematic scenes.

Important Notes

Format: Alembic (.abc)

Not usable for games

No rig / no retargeting

Designed for cinematics, renders, and animations only

Use Cases

Cinematic shots

Short films

Previsualization

Architectural & environmental renders

VFX and animation projects

Features

Smooth horse walk cycle

Realistic quadruped motion

Baked animation (stable & consistent)

Easy import into Blender, Maya, Houdini, Cinema 4D

results.name: Toon Horse with Saddle (Rigged, Animated)
results.description:
This model is rigged and animated. Model includes a Walk, Trot, and Gallop animation. This model is low poly and game engine ready.
Model was rigged using rigify, but uses a simplified bone hierarchy.
This model looks best with a toon shader.

Additional files include:
5 different textures to customize the color of the horse (Black, Brown, Dark Brown, Grey, White)
Blender File
